description.value: At the start of each of the bone wraith's turns, each creature within 10 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) slashing and 7 ([[/damage 2d6 necrotic]]).
If the bone wraith fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
The bone wraith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
The bone wraith's weapon attacks are magical.
The bone wraiths has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
The bone wraith uses its Graveyard Spike and then makes two melee weapon attacks.
Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15ft., one target. Hit:26 ([[/damage 3d12 + 7 slashing]]).
Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10ft., up to three targets. Hit:13 ([[/damage 1d12 + 7 slashing]]).

A medium sized spike of bone raises from the ground within 60 ft. of the bone wraith. A creature in the same space must make a DC 19 Dexterity save or take 11 ([[/damage 2d8 + 2 piercing]]) and be restrained. A restrained creature can use an action to try to break free by succeeding on a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. While restrained in this way, a creature takes 9 ([[/damage 2d8 piercing]]) at the start of each of the bone wraith's turns. On a successful save the creature takes half damage and is not restrained.

The bone wraith exhales an icy blast in a 90-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 56 ([[/damage 12d8 cold]]) on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Any creature within the bone wraith's bone storm aura must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) slashing and 7 ([[/damage 2d6 necrotic]]).
The bone wraith makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

The bone wraith strikes its spinal wing towards a creature. Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit:23 ([[/damage 3d10 + 7 piercing]]) and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength check or be grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The bone wraith can have maximum two creatures grappled this way.
